hero.subtitle: RuleBuilder lets you create multi-condition rules, group them with AND/OR, and preview readable plus JSON queries instantly.

categories.title: Filter on real contact attributes
categories.subtitle: Dropdown values load dynamically from MongoDB — nothing is hardcoded in the UI.

nearby.body: As you add rules and nesting markers, RuleBuilder generates a readable query string and a structured JSON representation for review and API use.

refer.title: Create nested filters in
refer.body: Support for unlimited nesting, group start/end markers, rule editing, search, drag-and-drop ordering, and saved templates.

steps.d: Choose Type, Field, Operator, and Value. Fields and values come from the API and MongoDB.
Use group markers and AND/OR/END to express nested conditions like ((A AND B) OR C).
Inspect live query criteria, save the rule set, then filter the contact collection.

blocks.label: Reusable UI
blocks.body: Buttons, inputs, tables, and rule rows are component-based for maintainability and reuse.

blocks.label: API-first backend
blocks.body: FastAPI endpoints for types, fields, values, preview, save, list, and delete — documented in Swagger.

blocks.label: MongoDB dataset
blocks.body: Contacts, type master, and field master collections drive every dropdown and filter result.

blocks.label: Quality practices
blocks.body: JWT auth, form validation, loading states, error handling, dark mode, Docker, and unit tests.

what.title: Everything required for dynamic nested rule building.
what.body: English, Hindi, and Odia UI content from JSON. Theme tokens in one file. Secrets only in .env. No hardcoded headings in components.
